systems.platform: central database with a unified scheme and software for the national, wilaya and foreign-ministry files
systems.tiers: national, fed instantly from the wilaya files; the security services supply vehicles stolen, wanted, under investigation, crashed or burnt, and have secured access to consult it

note: Official journal no. 60 of 2023 (decrees 23-316 on the national identification number and 23-317 on the vehicle registration file): no station record system is named. The vehicle file is a civil registry of the interior ministry that carries stolen and wanted flags from the security services; the traffic-offences information system is named only as one it is linked to. The gendarmerie appears otherwise only as a member of a humanitarian-law commission.
